proposed_fixes.title: Reproduce the supplied lambda stack by forcing activation failure and testing logging/API-reporting paths independently.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A failure escaping the activation lambda reaches an async-void UI exception boundary. The exact null object is not established; neither JIT/reflection speculation from closed PRs nor benign logo failures prove it.
plan: Reproduce the supplied lambda stack by forcing activation failure and testing logging/API-reporting paths independently.

Once the failing dereference is identified, guard or correct that dependency and observe activation through a task-returning error boundary rather than letting a secondary exception escape async void.
Report launch failure through the proper UI dispatcher and retain the original exception; do not blanket-suppress NullReferenceException.
Treat the all-windows-black symptom as a separate correlation until its timing/recovery confirms a connection.
verification: An unavailable or broken UWP target produces a bounded error instead of an unhandled activation-lambda exception.
Successful UWP launches and ordinary logo fallbacks continue working; unrelated failures remain diagnosable.

confidence.rationale: A failure escaping the activation lambda reaches an async-void UI exception boundary. The exact null object is not established; neither JIT/reflection speculation from closed PRs nor benign logo failures prove it.

reproduce.title: Verify PowerToys Run Programs plugin report
prerequisites: PowerToys Run Programs plugin enabled where applicable
setup: Use isolated UWP activation and reporting test doubles; do not uninstall or corrupt the user's apps.
Use the supplied fatal stack as the signature, not the separate missing-logo warnings.
steps: 1. Force ApplicationActivationManager.ActivateApplication to fail and observe the logging/error-reporting branch.
2. Exercise missing API/dependency and reporting failures individually to identify the actual null dereference.
3. Verify any revised activation Task is observed and that errors are marshalled to the UI without escaping an async-void continuation.
4. Compare process recovery and the reported desktop-wide black screen without assuming causality.
